title: Manage connected harnesses
text: Configuration now has a Harnesses page for connecting and disconnecting coding agents. The setup wizard verifies each connection before adding it. Agent menus and the usage bar follow the connections you’ve confirmed.
chapters: Keep only the harnesses selected during setup

more.title: Onboarding follows the harnesses you select
more.text: Onboarding uses the harnesses you select to set up your first project. If you choose only Codex, it becomes the sole connection and usage meter, even when an earlier preference named another harness.
chapters: Verify the connection, default, and usage

more.title: Harness settings reflect active connections
more.text: Harnesses shows when every available harness is already connected. After a disconnect, the project editor updates its Git requirement to match the harness that will run its workers.
chapters: Use a folder after disconnecting Antigravity
